general.title: L2P Analysis (Single)
general.instructions:
Attach one DEG input with mount name 'deg_table' to replace the mouse demo. Leave DEG Table File blank to discover the input only within that mount, or select a CSV, TSV, TXT, or RDS file explicitly. Discovery accepts one unambiguous DEG table; for a single Comparison, an exact diff_<comparison>.csv file is selected deterministically. Ambiguous files stop with their paths instead of choosing one silently.

The mouse demo preset runs B-A. For another table, use either Comparison for one analysis or Comparisons for ordered, independent runs. You may leave both blank only when the table contains exactly one complete comparison prefix using the configured suffixes; several detected prefixes stop for an explicit choice. Threshold selection (nominal p-value ≤ 0.05 and absolute fold change ≥ 1.2) is the default. Essential controls are under Main Settings; expand the Advanced categories to tune column detection, selection, pathway filtering, custom pathways, or plot appearance.

datasets.name: Demo DEG Table
datasets.description: Demo Mouse RNA-seq data (mount: deg_table). Replaced automatically when you attach your own dataset with the same mount name.

categories.name: Main Settings
categories.description: DEG input and the essential parameters for a standard run

categories.name: Advanced: Column Overrides
categories.description: Override auto-detected columns only when the input uses nonstandard names

categories.name: Advanced: Gene Selection
categories.description: Tune rank- or threshold-based gene selection

categories.name: Advanced: Pathway Filtering
categories.description: Tune pathway hit and significance filtering

categories.name: Advanced: Custom Pathways
categories.description: Use your own pathway database instead of or in addition to built-in collections

parameters.name: DEG Table File
parameters.description: Optional explicit CSV, TSV, TXT, or RDS differential-expression table. Leave blank to discover the input only within the attached data asset mounted as deg_table; ambiguous candidates are rejected.

parameters.name: Custom Pathway File
parameters.description: Optional custom pathway table (CSV, TSV, or TXT) or compatible RDS object. Leave blank to use only built-in collections.

parameters.name: Comparison
parameters.description: One comparison ID to analyze. The mouse demo preset is B-A. For your own table, replace it or leave both comparison controls blank only when exactly one complete prefix is detectable. Supply this or Comparisons, not both.

parameters.name: Comparisons (Optional)
parameters.description: Comma-separated comparison IDs for independent, ordered runs from one wide DEG table (for example, B-A,C-A,C-B). Leave Comparison blank. This mode auto-detects comparison-prefixed columns and writes one result folder per comparison.

parameters.name: Species
parameters.description: Species for ortholog mapping. Non-human genes are converted to human before L2P analysis

parameters.name: Pathway Collections
parameters.description: Type one or more database codes. To run multiple databases together, join codes with commas and no spaces (e.g. H,REACTOME,KEGG). Common codes: H = Hallmark gene sets; GO = Gene Ontology; REACTOME = Reactome pathways; KEGG = KEGG pathways; WikiPathways = WikiPathways gene sets; PANTH = PANTHER pathways; PID = Pathway Interaction Database; BIOCYC = BioCyc pathways; C1 = MSigDB positional gene sets; C2 = MSigDB curated gene sets; C3 = MSigDB motif/regulatory target gene sets; C4 = MSigDB computational gene sets; C5 = MSigDB Gene Ontology gene sets; C6 = MSigDB oncogenic signatures; C7 = MSigDB immunologic signatures; C8 = MSigDB cell type signatures.

parameters.name: Gene Names Column
parameters.description: Optional gene-symbol column. Leave blank to auto-detect GeneName (the demo and OMIX workflow default), then Gene Symbols and other common identifiers. Enter an exact column name to override.

parameters.name: T-Statistic Column
parameters.description: Optional t-statistic column override. Leave blank to auto-detect MOSuite 'tstat' or a comparison-prefixed column such as 'B-A_tstat'.

parameters.name: Significance Column
parameters.description: Optional significance-column override. Leave blank to auto-detect the nominal p-value column first (for example, 'pval' or 'B-A_pval'); adjusted p-values are only used when explicitly selected or when no nominal p-value is available.

parameters.name: Fold Change Column
parameters.description: Optional fold-change column override. Leave blank to auto-detect MOSuite 'FC' or a comparison-prefixed column such as 'B-A_FC'.

parameters.name: T-Statistic Suffix
parameters.description: Suffix appended to each comparison ID to resolve its ranking column. Exact single-comparison column overrides take precedence.

parameters.name: Significance Suffix
parameters.description: Suffix appended to each comparison ID to resolve its p-value or adjusted-p-value column. Exact single-comparison column overrides take precedence.

parameters.name: Fold Change Suffix
parameters.description: Suffix appended to each comparison ID to resolve its fold-change column. Exact single-comparison column overrides take precedence.

parameters.name: Select By Rank
parameters.description: Use the legacy t-statistic rank method. Leave FALSE (default) to select genes by nominal p-value ≤ 0.05 and absolute fold change ≥ 1.2.

parameters.name: Select Top Percentage
parameters.description: Select top percentage of genes (vs fixed number)

parameters.name: Number of Top Genes
parameters.description: Number of top genes to select (if not using percentage)

parameters.name: Significance Threshold
parameters.description: P-value threshold for gene selection (if not using rank)

parameters.name: Fold Change Threshold
parameters.description: Fold change threshold for gene selection (if not using rank)

parameters.name: Minimum DEG Genes
parameters.description: Minimum number of DEG genes required per comparison

parameters.name: Minimum Pathway Hits
parameters.description: Minimum genes required per pathway to be considered

parameters.name: P-value Threshold
parameters.description: P-value cutoff for including pathways in results (0 = include all)

parameters.name: Use Built-in Gene Universe
parameters.description: Use built-in gene universe instead of detected genes

parameters.name: Use FDR P-values
parameters.description: Use FDR-adjusted p-values for pathway significance

parameters.name: Pathway Name Column
parameters.description: Column name containing pathway names in custom file

parameters.name: Gene Symbol Column
parameters.description: Column name containing gene symbols in custom file

parameters.name: Number of Pathways to Plot
parameters.description: Maximum number of pathways to display in each plot

parameters.name: Pathway Label Max Length
parameters.description: Maximum character length for pathway names

parameters.name: Pathway Label Font Size
parameters.description: Font size for pathway labels

parameters.name: Custom Pathways Up
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of specific upregulated pathways to plot (overrides top selection)

parameters.name: Plot Top Pathways Down
parameters.description: Plot top downregulated pathways

parameters.name: Custom Pathways Down
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of specific downregulated pathways to plot (overrides top selection)
